title: New edge proposed: opening_range_breakout_with_pullback_reentry — E8 Intelligence Research
abstract: { "name": "opening_range_breakout_with_pullback_reentry", "source": "Toby Crabel, 'Day Trading with Short Term Price Patterns and Opening Range Breakout'", "type": "entry_engine", "rule": "Enter long if price breaks above the 30-minute opening range high by 0.2 ATR (20-period), then pulls back to touch that high again within 2 hours, confirmed by a bullish 3-bar reversal (higher low + close above previous close).", "pseudocode": "if time == 09:30: ORH = highest(high, 30min); if time >= 10:00 and prior 30min bar close > ORH + 0.2*ATR14_30min: if bar crosses below ORH then close > ORH within same bar: enter at close; stop = lowest(low, prior 2 bars); target = entry + 1.5 * (entry - stop)", "why_it_works": "Exploits the classic opening range breakout failure-to-hold (sweep) followed by a reclamation, representing an early-session liquidity grab that resolves in the direction of the prevailing momentum." } Author: Andrew Stewart Caldin, Independent Researcher, UK. Part of the E8 Intelligence Research series. Platform: e8intelligence.com
